title: Residential Electricity Supply Customer Agreement: Right of Rescission
content:
**Clause 1 (Right).** A customer may rescind a Residential Electricity Supply enrollment while the agreement is still enrollment pending.

**Clause 2 (Window).** The rescission is accepted only when the customer asks to rescind no later than the plan's rescission window, in calendar days, after the utility issued its enrollment confirmation, as shown by the utility confirmation date on the agreement. Day one is the calendar day after the utility confirmation date, and the window closes at the end of the calendar day equal to the utility confirmation date plus the rescission window days. The last day of the window is inside it.

**Clause 3 (Window not yet started).** When the utility confirmation date is still empty, the window has not started and a rescission is accepted.

**Clause 4 (No charge or credit).** A rescission carries no fee and no credit of any kind.

**Clause 5 (After supply starts).** Once supply has started the agreement can no longer be rescinded; the customer must cancel instead, and the early termination fee rules decide whether a fee applies.

The window is judged from the utility confirmation date recorded on the agreement being rescinded, not from the date the customer recalls receiving the letter. A rescission withdraws the enrollment request from the utility and the agreement becomes rescinded.

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical dates, using the 10-day window that every plan carries)

| Utility confirmation date | Rescission requested | Day of the window | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-05-02 | 2025-05-03 | day 1 | accepted |
| 2025-05-02 | 2025-05-12 | day 10, the last day | accepted |
| 2025-05-02 | 2025-05-13 | day 11 | not accepted |
| empty | any date while enrollment pending | window not started | accepted |
| any date | after supply has started | agreement active | not a rescission; cancellation rules apply |
